#en: Gagarin is the kind of place where old flight plans never really die, they just get folded into new smuggling routes and passed across bar tables with the serials filed off. If Vector needed a way to slip his corrections into the wild, he would bury them in the habits of haulers and shipbreakers here, trusting that no one looks too closely at paperwork that keeps the docks moving. Picking through those records on-site is the only way to separate his hand from ordinary graft. So far, the trail is a dusty dataslate on a backwater rock, a crooked beacon in high orbit, and freighter crews here who swear their ships veered from disaster for no good reason and refuse to talk about how.
zh: 加加林星就是那种旧飞行计划永远不会真正死掉的地方——它们只是被折进新的走私航线，磨掉序列号后在酒吧桌上传来传去。如果"向量"需要一条把自己的修正溜进荒野的路子，他会把它们埋进此地货船船员与拆船工的习气里，笃信没人会细看那些维持船坞运转的文书。在现场翻检这些记录，是把他那只手与普通贪腐区分开的唯一办法。目前为止，这条线索是穷乡岩石上一块积灰的数据板、高轨道上一座歪斜的信标，以及此地那些发誓自己的船无缘无故地避开了灾祸、却拒绝谈论经过的货船船员。

#en: Whatever this place was built for, it is a grave now, wrapped in ice and humming on power it should not still have. The only working machinery sits behind overturned bunks and scorched bulkheads where Outcast Phalanx have dug in, ex-military ghosts guarding a cluster of systems that keep whispering tiny course changes into the storms overhead. Some say a freighter's flight path bent the moment it passed this sky, others swear it was a Navy run that vanished after pinging this grid, but every fragment agrees on one thing: the twisted beacon in that frozen lab, the dead convoy vectors, and the altered descent logs all trace back here, to this forgotten node in the middle of nowhere.
zh: 无论这地方当初是为着什么造的，它如今是一座坟墓，裹在冰里，靠它本不该还拥有的电力嗡鸣。唯一还在运转的机械，就在被逐方阵据守的翻倒床铺与烧焦舱壁之后——一群前军人的幽灵，守着几套一直在朝头顶的风暴里低语细微航向改动的系统。有人说一艘货船的飞行路径在穿过这片天空的瞬间就弯了，也有人发誓那是一次海军航行，在向这片网格发出讯号后便消失了，但每一块碎片都同意一件事：那座冰封实验室里扭曲的信标、死掉的车队向量，以及被改动的下降日志，全都追溯到这里——这片鸟不拉屎之地中央这座被遗忘的节点。

#en: The PX-2395 drifts just outside the crowded lanes, lights dead, hull scuffed with impacts that never made it into any incident log, a SysDef asset quietly abandoned where no one has to file the right paperwork. If Torque wanted a place to rewrite history, this is it; a forgotten node in the enforcement chain where spin data, drive calibrations, and maintenance overrides could be massaged until every failure looks like tired metal instead of careful hands. You tracked the pattern from that lonely surface facility to a cold orbital cache, then through a tightening circle of edited records and frightened bar talk, until every rumor began to sound less like panic and more like policy.
zh: PX-2395就漂在拥挤的航道之外，灯光熄灭，船壳上尽是那些从未进入任何事故日志的撞击痕——一件被悄悄遗弃的星防队资产，遗弃在没人需要补办手续的地方。如果"扭矩"想找个地方改写历史，那就是这里：执法链条上一个被遗忘的节点，自旋数据、引擎标定与维护覆写都可以在这里被揉捏，直到每一次故障看起来都像金属疲劳，而不是一只有所图谋的手。你从地面上那座孤零零的设施追到这个冰冷的轨道储藏点，再穿过一圈越收越紧的涂改记录与惊恐的酒吧闲谈，直到每一则传闻听起来都不再像恐慌、而更像政策。

#en: Out here, among the gutted frames and half-melted hulls, the scrapyard still hums with routines no one bothered to shut down. Old Deimos traffic beacons flicker awake at your approach, pinging obsolete protocols Luca helped design, and buried in that noise his private patterns surface, guiding derelict cranes and dormant tugs like a ghost hand. This place is where his past and present share the same coordinates, where forgotten cleanup code can be twisted into one last killing corridor or finally silenced. From the first stray dataslate to the whispers in Neon and the corrupted scout ship logs, every trail has pointed back to him bending procedures that should have died years ago.
zh: 在这里，在被掏空的框架与半融的船壳之间，废料场仍在发出无人费心关掉的程序嗡鸣。你靠近时，火卫二的旧交通信标闪醒过来，发出卢卡协助设计的老旧协议讯号，而他的私人模式就在那片噪声中浮现，像一只幽灵之手引导着废弃吊臂与休眠拖船。这地方是他的过去与现在共享同一坐标之处，是被遗忘的清理代码可以被扭成最后一条杀戮走廊、或终于被噤声之处。从第一块散落数据板，到霓虹城的低语，再到损坏的侦察船日志，每一条线索都指回他——他在弯折那些本该在多年前就死掉的程序。

#en: Whoever scrubbed this relay did it fast and dirty, cutting power to half the decks and locking the core behind security they did not have time to finish wiring. The Division Garrison detail left bootprints in dust that should have been vacuumed years ago, ration tins still open, a helmet rolled into a corner like someone dropped it mid-sentence. Their orders were to seal the past and walk away, trusting that no one would bother an obsolete node on the edge of nowhere. What they missed lingers in the buffers: stray bursts toward a forgotten farm system, a doctor's unfiled bloodwork, and a smuggler's route that all bend toward the same thin thread of altered air and nervous denials.
zh: 擦净这座中继的人做得又快又糙：切掉一半甲板的电力，把核心锁在他们没时间接完线的安保之后。师部驻军分队在早该在多年前就吸净的尘土里留下脚印，配给罐还开着，一顶头盔滚在角落里，像有人在说话说到一半就把它掉了。他们的命令是封存过去然后走人，笃信没人会去打扰这片鸟不拉屎之地边缘一个过时的节点。他们漏掉的东西滞留在缓冲区里：朝某个被遗忘农场星系发出的零散脉冲、一名医生未归档的验血报告，以及一条走私航线——它们全都弯向同一根由被改动的大气和紧张的否认组成的细线。

#en: The Navy scout hanging dead in this orbit is where his story stopped being rumor and started bending steel. Whatever burned out BL-6924, it happened mid-routine, with no distress call, no diversion order, just a subtle skew in its last recorded jumps. If any ship would carry an untouched record of those offsets, it is this one, sealed in the dark before the reports could be massaged and the holes filled in. So far I have a ghost trace from a remote rock, doctored instructions on a Trade Authority courier, and talk of delay codes that never matched the traffic; the pattern keeps pointing back to one quiet controller who learned to change futures the way others change a shift roster.
zh: 这艘死寂地悬在此轨道的海军侦察船，正是他的故事不再是传闻、而开始掰弯钢铁的地方。无论是什么烧毁了 BL-6924，它都发生在例行之中：没有遇险呼叫、没有转向命令，只有它最后记录的几次跃迁里一道细微的偏斜。若说有哪艘船会带着那些偏移的未被动过的记录，那就是这一艘——在报告被揉捏、窟窿被填上之前就封存于黑暗之中。目前为止，我有一道来自偏远岩石的幽灵痕迹、一份贸易管理局信使船上的伪造指令，以及关于与交通状况从来对不上的延迟代码的说辞；这个模式不断指回同一名安静的调度员——他学会了改变未来，就像别人改排班表一样。

#en: Gagarin Landing is where the numbers finally stop being abstract. The gutted mech plants, the new corporate shells, the angry tow crews nursing cheap drinks and older grudges, all sit on top of the very infrastructure Deadweight has been bleeding dry. Here, among half-repurposed factories and promised jobs that never came, he can vanish into a crowd of people the insurers already wrote off, while he brokers one last trade in stolen hulls and buried data. The trail started in a forgotten cache on a backworld, wound through whispered coordinates at a lonely waystation, and sharpened aboard a derelict UC warship where doctored registries and rigging logs exposed the same careful hand.
zh: 加加林着陆点，就是那些数字终于不再抽象的地方。被掏空的机甲厂、新盖的公司的空壳、一边灌着廉价酒一边记着更旧仇怨的愤怒拖船队，全都坐落在"自重"一直在抽干的那套基础设施之上。在这里，在半途改作他用的工厂与从未兑现的就业承诺之间，他能消失进一群已被保险公司注销的人当中，同时做最后一笔赃船体与埋藏数据的交易。这条线索始于一穷乡星上被遗忘的储藏点，绕过一座孤零零中转站里的低语坐标，又在一艘废弃的联殖军舰上变得锐利——那里被做手脚的登记册与索具日志，露出了同一只谨慎的手。

#en: This forgotten depot is where freight goes to be un-counted, a place the manifests never properly reach and no regulator wants to remember. The haulers squatting here move cargo for anyone who pays in unmarked chips, and their loyalty is to silence, not flags. If there was a paper-thin record of when official shipments bled into unlogged tows, it would have been buried in these rusting stacks and chemical stains, guarded by people who suddenly find the floor very interesting whenever missing convoys are mentioned. So far, all I have are a stray dataslate from a backworld rock and vague talk of altered routes whispered by freight hands who swear they did not see who signed the orders.
zh: 这座被遗忘的货运站，是货物被"减账"的地方——舱单永远送不到、监管者也从不愿记得的地方。蹲在这里的货船船员替任何用无标记芯片付钱的人运货，他们效忠的是沉默，而不是旗帜。若说官方货物渗成未登记拖运这件事还有什么纸一样薄的记录，它早就被埋在这些锈蚀的货堆与化学污渍里，由一群人守着——每当提到失踪车队，他们就会突然觉得地板特别有意思。目前为止，我只有穷乡岩石上一块散落数据板，以及货运工们低声说出的、关于被改动航线的含糊说法；他们发誓没看见是谁签的那些命令。

#en: The freighter's corridors still hum with residual power, but its crew are long gone, leaving only the quiet tick of cooling metal and a bridge full of abandoned course data. Whatever passed through their hands here was treated like routine traffic, filed away and forgotten before anyone realized how those tiny heading changes stitched together into something larger. This ship is where the pattern first took hold, where someone nudged a single route off-axis and set a chain of transits drifting toward an unseen design. So far, all you have is a stray dataslate from deep space and this derelict hauler, both hinting that ordinary captains have been unknowingly flying someone else's plan.
zh: 这艘货船的走廊仍因残余电力而嗡鸣，可它的船员早已不在，只留下冷却金属的轻微滴答，以及一座塞满被弃航向数据的舰桥。凡是从他们手中经过的东西，都被当作日常交通处理，归档并被遗忘，没人意识到那些微小的航向改动如何缝成了更大的东西。这艘船就是那个模式最初扎根的地方——有人把一条航线轻推出轴线，就此让一连串航次朝一个看不见的设计漂去。目前为止，你只有一块来自深空的散落数据板与这艘废弃货船，它们都暗示普通船长们一直在不知不觉中飞着别人的计划。

#en: Once, this relay tied neat, official corridors together; now it just hangs in the dark, gutted consoles flickering with afterimages of jumps no one wants to admit happened. Anything left here is as close to untouched truth as this story is going to get, before it is laundered through barroom gossip and half-remembered debriefs. The ex-soldiers squatting in the station know that, which is why they are here instead of some cleaner posting. So far the trail has been a string of absences: a nameless cache on a forgotten rock, a silenced node on the fringe, and the same cold, precise jump signature whispered about in dockside corners as if saying it plainly might make whole ships reappear.
zh: 这座中继曾经把整齐的官方走廊系在一起；如今它只是悬在黑暗中，被掏空的控制台闪烁着没人愿意承认发生过的跃迁残像。留在这里的任何东西，都已是这个故事在被酒吧闲话与记忆模糊的述职洗白之前，最接近未经触碰之真相的样子。蹲守在这座星际站里的老兵们明白这一点，所以他们才在这里，而不是在某个更干净的岗位。目前为止，这条线索是一连串空缺：被遗忘岩石上一座无名储藏点、边境上一座被噤声的节点，以及那个在码头角落里被低声议论的、同样冰冷而精确的跃迁签名——仿佛把它清楚说出来，就能让整艘整艘的船重新出现。

#en: The dead depot is the only place a record like this could survive: buried under misrouted manifests, sealed cargo pods, and systems that have not synced to GalBank or the Trade Authority in years. Whatever is encoded here was meant to live in the gaps, tying together tug signatures, vanished containers, and routes everyone insists never existed. The Shattered Scrappers cling to it without understanding, guarding the one thread that might still show where her trail breaks from rumor into fact. So far all you have are fragments: a stray dataslate on a forgotten rock, nervous whispers in a research module, and a relay station humming with ghost traffic that never matched any official log.
zh: 这座死掉的货运站，是这种记录唯一能存活的地方：埋在错投的舱单、封存的货舱与多年未与盖尔银行或贸易管理局同步的系统之下。这里编码的一切，本该活在缝隙里，把拖船签名、消失的货柜，以及人人都坚称从不存在的航线绑在一起。破碎拆解帮不懂它却死死抓着它，守着那根也许还能显示她的痕迹从传闻转为事实的线索。目前为止，你只有碎片：被遗忘岩石上一块散落数据板、研究舱里紧张的低语，以及一座嗡鸣着从未与任何官方日志对上过的幽灵交通的中继站。

#en: The cache hangs alone in high orbit, a dead box wired into forgotten transit tables, quietly feeding poisoned numbers into lanes nobody audits anymore. Breaking it here, in the dark between patrol sweeps, is the only way to stop those warped solutions from seeding more "accidents" while its creator keeps moving. Its casing bears serials that do not match any current registry, and the logs slotted inside jump between systems like a nervous whisper, as if someone dismantled a larger story and scattered it piece by piece. All I have so far are a corrupted buoy core, mismatched dock records, and rumors traded in backroom bars, each one repeating the same name with a different kind of fear.
zh: 那座储藏点孤悬于高轨道，一个被接进遗忘运输表里的死盒子，悄悄把被下毒的数字喂进再没人审计的航道。在这里、在巡逻圈之间的黑暗中把它打碎，是阻止那些扭曲的解在造物主继续行动时播下更多"意外"的唯一办法。它的外壳上带着与任何现行登记册都对不上的序列号，而插在里面的日志在各星系之间跳来跳去，像一声紧张的耳语，仿佛有人把一则更大的故事拆开、一块一块地撒了出去。目前为止我只有一枚损坏的浮标核心、对不上的船坞记录，以及在密室酒吧里交易的传闻，每一个都用不同种类的恐惧重复着同一个名字。

#en: The monitoring pod sits buried under rock and ice, a sealed habit no one bothered to break. Its consoles still glow dim green, cycling through old interception routines that were never meant to run this long. Somewhere in that loop a quiet adjustment was made, a new pattern of salvage beacons and erased ship IDs slipped into the schedule, and nobody noticed because the system kept humming. This is where the first records of her crossing UC paths off the books were cached and forgotten. All you have so far is a stray dataslate from a dead outpost and an analyst's decrypted scraps hinting that someone inside the Navy rewrote standard operating procedure to protect one ghost in the traffic.
zh: 那座监控舱埋在岩石与冰层之下，一处没人费心打开的封闭巢穴。它的控制台仍发出黯淡的绿光，循环着本不该运行这么久的旧拦截程序。在那循环的某处，一处安静的调整被做了出来：一种由打捞信标与被抹除的船只 ID 构成的新模式溜进了日程，而没人注意到，因为系统仍在嗡鸣。这里正是她账外穿越联殖航路的最初记录被缓存并遗忘的地方。目前为止，你只有一座死掉前哨的散落数据板，以及一名分析员被解密出来的残片——它暗示海军内部有人改写了标准操作程序，只为保护交通里的一个幽灵。

#en: The bunker is where the chain of small mistakes began: a relay no one fully decommissioned, a patrol grid revision no one double-checked, a lone tech whose questions were answered with silence instead of clarification. Here, half-retired consoles still hum with forgotten routines, and the air smells of old sealant and stale coffee, like a shift that never officially ended. Buried in these walls are the first records of a ship slipping through restricted sky on vectors that make no sense, flagged once, then cleared with a shrug. All I have so far is a shaken technician's copy of those scans and scattered chatter about a blacklisted navigator nudging traffic where it should never have gone.
zh: 这座掩体，就是那串小错误开始的地方：一座没人彻底停用的中继、一次没人复核的巡逻网格修订、一名提问只换来沉默而非解答的孤独技师。在这里，半退役的控制台仍在发出被遗忘程序的嗡鸣，空气里是旧密封胶与放凉咖啡的味道，像一次从未正式结束的班次。这些墙里埋着一艘船以毫无道理的向量溜过禁飞天空的最初记录——被标记过一次，然后被耸耸肩放行了。目前为止，我只有一名技术员颤抖着留下那些扫描的副本，以及关于一名被列入黑名单的领航员把交通推向它绝不该去之处零散的闲谈。

#en: In the polished arteries of Neon, this is as close as anyone gets to the city's nervous system without a corporate badge. Terminals here sit between street and sky, where local purchases, transit pings, and off world traffic all pass through the same quiet choke points. Somewhere in that flow is a single out of place marker, a tiny authorization that does not fit any official route, the sort of detail clerks skim past and security pretends not to see. Catch it here, at the source, and you can follow where her signal climbs. So far all you have is a burned dataslate from a forgotten rock and a handful of barroom stories about a memory thief who walks out of vaults with nothing in her hands.
zh: 在霓虹城光洁的动脉里，这是没有公司徽章的人所能抵达的、最接近这座城市神经系统的地方。这里的终端位于街道与天空之间，本地采购、交通脉冲与太空交通全都穿过同样几个安静的咽喉。在那道人流里，某处有一个孤零零的不合位置标记：一项与任何官方航线都对不上的微小授权，正是那种文书会一扫而过、安保会假装没看见的细节。在这里、在源头处抓住它，你就能循着她的信号往上爬。目前为止，你只有被遗忘岩石上一块烧焦的数据板，以及几则酒吧故事——关于一名走出金库时两手空空、却偷走记忆的贼。

#en: The LX-3802 hangs cold in patrol space, lights dark, transponder still whispering UC SysDef authority like a bad joke everyone keeps repeating. This is where the story says a whole taskforce learned too much about bent ledgers and then went silent, where someone tore the heart out of their records and left the hull to drift as a warning. If any trace of that work survived, it will be in the bones of this ship, locked behind systems only a few analysts ever understood. So far the trail is all paper ghosts and secondhand fear: a stray dataslate in the dust, a quiet anomaly in orbital traffic, and scattered talk in bars about a GalBank ghost who edits lives without ever leaving a fingerprint.
zh: LX-3802冰冷地悬在巡逻空域，灯光熄灭，应答器仍在低声念叨着联殖星防队的权威，像一个所有人都在重复的冷笑话。故事说，一整支特遣队正是在这里对弯折的账本知道得太多，然后陷入沉默；有人把他们记录的心脏挖了出来，任船壳漂着当警告。若说那项工作还有一丝痕迹留存，它就在这艘船的骨架里，锁在只有少数分析员才看得懂的系统之后。目前为止，这条线索全是纸上的幽灵与二手的恐惧：尘土里一块散落数据板、轨道交通里一处安静的异常，以及酒吧里零散的闲谈——关于一个从不留下指纹、却能改写人生的盖尔银行幽灵。

#en: The pit is nothing but twisted hull and stripped engines tossed into a shallow scar in the dirt, the kind of place where routes and reputations both come to be dismantled. If he was going to purge his trail, a scrap dealer's back table is exactly where a datapack would get cracked for parts and forgotten, its fragments of flight paths and relay handshakes sinking quietly into the noise. Pulling those pieces back together here matters because this is where all the discarded routes converge. So far the line has run from a dead colony's broken logs to a doctored beacon and a half-erased audit below the city, each step leaving only faint imprints in systems never meant to carry that much truth.
zh: 那个坑里只有扭曲的船壳与被剥光零件的引擎，被丢进土中一道浅浅的伤疤，正是航线与名声都会被拆解掉的那类地方。若他想清掉自己的痕迹，废品商的后桌正是数据包会被拆成零件然后被遗忘的地方——它的那些飞行路径与中继握手碎片，正悄悄沉进噪声里。在这里把这些碎片重新拼回来之所以要紧，是因为这里是所有被丢弃航线汇聚之处。目前为止，这条线从一座死掉殖民地损坏的日志，延伸到一座被做手脚的信标与城市下方一份半擦除的审计，每一步都只在那些从没打算承载这么多真相的系统里留下淡淡印痕。

#en: The trail bends back to this quiet rock, where survey drones have come and gone for years without asking why local records never quite match what the central systems think is here. Whatever was buried in these outbuildings needed distance from patrol routes and enough neglect that no one questioned a little ledger drift on a nowhere world. Leaving it untouched any longer means letting old errors calcify into truth, and whoever has been hiding behind them will keep moving under cover of clerical noise. So far I have scraps only: a farmer's reversed foreclosure, a scratched dataslate lost in the dust, and an orbital relay whose traffic logs lied the way only practiced hands can teach them to.
zh: 线索绕回这块安静的岩石：勘探无人机多年来来来去去，从没问过为什么本地记录总与中枢系统以为此处该有的情况对不上。埋在这些外屋里的东西，需要远离巡逻航线，也需要足够被忽视，以至于没人会质疑一个鸟不拉屎世界上那点账册漂移。再不动它，就意味着让旧的错误钙化成真相，而一直躲在它们背后的人会继续以文书噪声为掩护行动。目前为止，我只有一些残片：一名农场主被撤销的止赎、一块丢在尘土里被划花的数据板，以及一座轨道中继——它的交通日志说谎的方式，只有老练的手才能教得出来。

#en: The old GalBank hull drifts just off the lanes, lights gutted, transponders cold, yet every account that ever passed through it still reverberates in sealed racks deep inside. If anyone nudged the credit lattice from the shadows, they would have done it from a place like this, where custody chains end and auditors rely on trust instead of proof. Buried among encrypted manifests and frozen ledgers should be the one trace that survives rumor, the echo of the hand that taught Nyla how to cut debts free. All we truly have so far are a nameless slate on a dead rock, skewed shipping numbers from Gagarin, and whispers of a mentor who moves through GalBank files like a ghost no one will admit exists.
zh: 那具盖尔银行的旧船壳就漂在航道外侧，灯光被掏空、应答器冰冷，可每一个曾经过它之手的账户，仍在它深处密封的机架里回响。若有人从暗处拨动了信贷网格，他们一定是在这样的地方做的——在这里，托管链条终止，审计员靠信任而非证据行事。在加密舱单与冻结账册之间，本该埋着唯一能超越传闻而存活下来的痕迹：那只教会妮拉如何把债务切离出去的、手的回声。目前为止我们真正拥有的，只有死寂岩石上一块无名数据板、来自加加林星对不上的航运数字，以及关于一名导师的低语——他在盖尔银行文件里穿行，像一个没人愿意承认存在的幽灵。

#en: Only here, on the silent hull of a forgotten UC Vanguard warship, can the story be peeled back to the moment it bent off course. PX-9199 drifted out of the official record the same way her squadron did, lost to a string of rushed orders, garbled coordinates, and quiet corrections no one wanted to own. Its bulkheads still remember what the debrief room on Jemison buried, each logged jump and half-finished command a frozen miscommunication that nudged a veteran wing toward an uncharted grave. Back in Neon's corporate glass you traced altered flight contracts and hushed payouts; now the pattern feels less like conspiracy, more like a chain of small, disastrous errors converging on the same pilot.
zh: 只有在这里、在这艘被遗忘的联殖先锋队军舰沉默的船壳上，这个故事才能被剥回到它偏离航向的那一刻。"PX-9199"像她的中队一样漂出了官方记录，迷失在一连串仓促的命令、错乱的坐标和无人愿意认领的安静修正里。它的舱壁仍记得杰米森星上那间述职室埋掉了什么：每一次被记录的跃迁、每一条半途而废的命令，都是一段冻结的沟通失误，把一支老牌飞行队推向一座未标注的坟墓。回到霓虹城的公司玻璃里，你追踪过被改动的飞行合同与压低声音的付款；如今这个模式感觉不再像阴谋，更像一连串小而灾难性的错误，汇聚到同一名飞行员身上。

#en: Out here, the orbit is empty enough that anything left drifting is either forgotten or worth killing for, and this cache sits exactly where his kind of mind would hide a pattern in plain vacuum. The ship circling it holds just enough firepower to scare off scavengers, not enough to trigger official interest, which fits a surveyor who has learned how far he can push before systems notice. Voices on the last rock swore they saw ghost pings and misaligned beacons up here; others laughed it off as spacer superstition. So far, the trail runs from that remote dead world to an orbital anomaly and a quiet Trade Authority hull, all pointing to one architect behind doctored surveys and vanished settlers.
zh: 在这里，轨道空旷到任何还在漂着的东西，要么是被遗忘的，要么是值得为它杀人的；而这座储藏点恰好位于他那种头脑会把模式藏进赤裸真空的地方。绕着它转的那艘船，火力刚好够吓退拾荒者，又不足以引来官方关注——这正符合一名已学会"在系统注意到之前能推多远"的勘探员。上一块岩石上的人发誓说，他们在上面见过幽灵脉冲和错位的信标；另一些人则一笑置之，说那是太空劫匪的迷信。目前为止，线索从那颗遥远的死寂世界，延伸到一处轨道异常与一具沉默的贸易管理局船壳，全都指向同一个幕后设计者——被做手脚的勘探与消失的定居者背后的人。

#en: The bunker is the last place where the skies above this sector were honestly measured. The old UC array here once watched every ascent and reentry, its filters sharp enough to catch even the thin signatures of restricted flights. Whoever copied those scans understood they were seeing something they should not, but they pulled the data and walked away before the pattern resolved into anything more than a discomfort they could not name.  \n\nSo far the trail runs from a forgotten cache on a lonely rock, through a silenced satellite recorder and redacted oversight reports, into improvised power work at Gagarin and a research tower whose models all bend toward the same hidden corridor in jump space.
zh: 这座掩体，是这片星域上空的天空最后一次被如实测量的地方。这里的老联殖阵列曾注视着每一次升空与再入，它的过滤器锐利到连受限制飞行的稀薄特征都抓得住。复制那些扫描的人明白，他们看到的是自己不该看到的东西，可他们还是把数据拷走、转身离开，那时这个模式还没有凝聚成任何比一种说不出口的不适更多的东西。  \n\n目前为止，线索从一块孤独岩石上被遗忘的储藏点，穿过一台被噤声的卫星记录仪与涂黑的监督报告，进入加加林星上临时拼凑的电力工程，再到一座其模型全都弯向跃迁空间中同一条隐藏走廊的研究塔。

#en: The freighter drifts dark between lanes, power bled down to the bare minimum, perfect cover for records no one wants in a public ledger. This hull is where routes are laundered and cargo histories scrubbed; any list that survives in its systems was meant for backroom whispers, not audits. If Vector has bent Trade Authority shipping to feed her ghost-yards, the pattern of those corrections will be etched in whatever manifests escaped the purge, buried in a ship no one bothers to tow home.  \n\nSo far the trail runs from a forgotten rock with a discarded dataslate to a silent UC relay full of half-erased sensor logs, each hinting at the same unseen pilot nudging traffic just off the charted lanes.
zh: 那艘货船黑暗地漂在航道之间，电力被抽到最低限度，是那些没人想放进公开账册的记录最好的掩护。这具船壳正是航线被洗白、货物历史被擦净的地方；凡是能在它系统里留下来的清单，都是为密室低语、而非审计准备的。如果"向量"弯折了贸易管理局的航运来喂养她的幽灵船坞，那些修正的模式就会镌刻在任何逃过清理的舱单上，埋在一艘没人费心拖回家的船里。  \n\n目前为止，线索从一块带着被丢弃数据板的被遗忘岩石，延伸到一座塞满半擦除传感器日志的沉默联殖中继，每一处都暗示着同一名隐形飞行员正把交通推向已标注航道的边缘。

#en: In the deserted listening post, old routines still hum beneath the dust, automated sweeps ticking through sky they no longer officially watch. Somewhere in that forgotten rhythm, the records of a ship that should not exist kept slipping past, its course adjustments smoothed over by systems no human bothered to review. This is where the first lie took root, not as a grand conspiracy but as a neglected process, quietly folding an outlaw's path into the background noise. All I know so far is that a dead station saw something the public charts never recorded, and that someone valued those overlooked readings enough to send a gang like Heat Ridge to sit on them long after everyone else stopped caring.
zh: 在那座废弃的听音哨里，旧程序仍在尘土之下嗡鸣，自动扫描仍在扫过它们已不再官方监视的天空。在那被遗忘的韵律中，一艘不该存在的船的记录不断溜过，它的航向修正被那些没人费心复核的系统抹平。这里正是第一个谎言的扎根之处——不是一场宏大的阴谋，而是一个被忽视的流程，悄悄把一个法外之徒的路径折进背景噪声。目前为止我只知道，一座死掉的监测站看见了公开星图从不曾记录的东西，而有人珍视那些被忽略的读数到愿意派出"热脊帮"这样的帮派，在其他所有人都不再关心之后还守着它们。
